hostEmail.description: Email address for the meeting host. This attribute should only be set if the user or application calling the API has the admin-level scopes. When used, the admin may specify the email of a user in a site they manage to be the meeting host. The field is not editable and is only used to share or unshare a recording link on behalf of the real meeting host.

webShareLink.description: The link for the recording to be shared or unshared.

addEmails.description: Email addresses of users to share the recording link with. The maximum size of the array is `100`.

removeEmails.description: Email addresses of users to unshare the recording link with. The maximum size of the array is `100`.

sendEmail.description: Whether to send email notifications to the users being shared. The default is `true`.
